summary.name: Swifty
summary.one_liner: Swifty is a free, offline-first password manager for macOS, Windows and Linux, listed on getswifty.pro.
use_cases: store and manage online account passwords
keep passwords offline on a desktop
password management on windows or linux
summary.what_it_does: The page is mostly a blog index of password manager reviews and unrelated business articles, so little is stated about Swifty itself. The listing text describes Swifty as a free, offline-first password manager for macOS, Windows and Linux. It is linked to an open-source project at github.com/swiftyapp/swifty. The page itself does not document specific features.
notable: Listed as open-source software with freeware status in awesome-mac
caveats: Page content is mostly a blog listing; product features are not described on the page
Pricing is described only as freeware in a third-party listing
